findings.title: A chained review cannot write 'Chained: granted by chain.<key>.' into final_assessment: the review emit owns that field
findings.recommendation: The walk's fix for the missing chained-run record puts the sentence in every chained command's run summary `final_assessment` (No-chaining contract, design.md Decision 8, task 3.1). For `review`, `final_assessment` is engine-owned: `ENGINE_OWNED_EXTRA.review` in src/core/emit-composition.ts:261 lists it, so `orbit emit review` refuses a payload carrying it. A chained in-context or fresh review therefore cannot record the sentence as the requirement says, and task 3.1 cannot be implemented as written. The walk's sentence does hold for the walk, whose `final_assessment` is a payload field, and for an external review's T0 (payloadFields at emit-composition.ts:211). Fix one of two ways: (A) state where each record goes — the walk and the external T0 in `final_assessment`, an in-context or fresh pass in its optional `commentary` — and restate Decision 8 and task 3.1 to match; or (B) keep the sentence for the walk alone and state the review case as a named limit until the second change's consent value.

recommendation_options.label: A
recommendation_options.body: Route the sentence by record: final_assessment for the walk and the external T0, commentary for an in-context or fresh review pass; restate the No-chaining contract sentence, Decision 8 and task 3.1.

recommendation_options.label: B
recommendation_options.body: Keep the sentence for the walk only and record chained reviews as a named limit in design.md's Risks.

findings.reproduction: grep -n "review: \['final_assessment'" src/core/emit-composition.ts → 261: review: ['final_assessment', 'iteration', 'pass_genre', 'verified_walks', 'decision_records_owed'] (the rejected-in-payload list); specs/orbit-conventions/spec.md:13-14 requires a chained command's final_assessment to carry the sentence.

walk_entry.title: User-facing docs keep saying the AI never runs the next step unasked; only customization.md is in the tasks

commentary: Graded each resolved entry of both walks over its file, its ripple paths and its sweep scope. Re-read the three deltas, re-ran strict validate, and ran the residual diff from the pair's base commit: every edited file is in some entry's edit record. Checked the new head rule against the sequences codex raised: a single failed launch, a refused save, and a blind pair whose fresh half lands while its external half fails. Each stops at no-progress within one relaunch. Re-enumerated every AskUserQuestion site in the two generated skills and their references against the widened prompt table; each is a listed row or a mention for the new not-a-prompt tag. A stop record carries a question field, so asking the open stop's question is implementable. The two stale entries in the external log are correct calls. One fix does not hold: the review emit owns final_assessment.
